messages:
maria: Quick UX check — noticed weird drag ghosting in the routing editor when reordering compact rule cards. Also the preview sim heatmap gets clipped on narrow viewports. Can we triage?
charlie: Seen it. The ghost overlaps the drop target by ~6px on condensed lists. Looks like a z-index or transform offset issue. Screenshot attached. :eyes: 
anya: I can reproduce. Happens when we animate with transform in condensed mode; placeholder height calc seems off.
kevin: If we use transform for animation, hit-testing can still use original layout. Options: toggle pointer-events on the ghost or switch dragging to absolute top/left while keeping animation. Tradeoffs: visual smoothness vs predictable hitbox.
charlie: For visuals, prefer ghost to be semi-transparent and not cover the drop affordance. Suggest ghost opacity 0.7 + dashed placeholder outline showing exact drop anchor.
maria: Also copy nit for sim preview empty state: currently "No matching routes found" — product wants friendlier wording. Proposal: "No active routing rules match this input yet."
lydia: A11y: screenreader announces "dragging" but doesn't announce new position after drop. Need an aria-live update like: aria-live="polite" announcement: "Rule X moved to position 2". Also ensure placeholder is focusable for keyboard reordering.
anya: Will add aria-live update on successful reorder and keyboard handle focus state. For ghost fix I'll try switching to absolute positioning during drag to get consistent hit boxes.
kevin: I'll change the validation toast anchor so it doesn't overlap sim controls — anchor to rules panel instead of top nav. Also will make the sim legend collapse under a chevron below 720px to avoid clipping.
charlie: Heatmap clipping is because preview canvas has overflow:hidden at narrow widths. Allow vertical scroll inside preview pane and collapse legend for <720px.
maria: Timeline: can we get a tiny patch for copy + toast anchoring + ghost fix for next sprint (starts Monday)? Lydia will run SR tests after PRs land.
lydia: I'll run screenreader pass after merges and post failing cases here so QA can add tests.
anya: Opening PR for ghost/keyboard updates today, will link it here.
kevin: I'll open a separate PR for toast anchor and legend collapse.
ux-bot: Reminder: add unit test for drop-placeholder calc and an accessibility checklist item for route reordering. :white_check_mark: 
maria: Final copy change: "No active routing rules match this input yet. Try relaxing filters or add a new rule." Can we land that with the copy PR?
charlie: Sounds good. I'll update the design spec and include the dashed placeholder mock.
maria: Thanks team — tagging for sprint planning. :rocket:
